machine: Apple M3 Mac15,13 macOS26.2; eight physical CPUs; compilers, tests and profilers idle during latency and resource cohorts

timing_boundaries.upstream: Original upstream timer, with global pool preinitialized, retained only as a labeled historical reference.
timing_boundaries.matched_worker_lifecycle: Both implementations create, run and join workers inside processing; JSON decoding excluded. Mech admission is additional and separately reported.
timing_boundaries.whole_process: Parent monotonic clock around fresh subprocess launch through exit, including JSON IO, artifact restoration, admission, computation and teardown. OS file cache is not flushed.
timing_boundaries.post_json: One continuous interval includes input preparation and allocations plus computation and worker create/run/join. Mech supplies post_json_seconds; Rust supplies its documented processing timer. JSON IO and Mech artifact restoration are included in the separate complete-process measurement.

experiment.candidate: Fuel-derived child debit totals with all existing header funding checks

implementations.name: rust
implementations.processing_boundary: JSON decoding outside timer; tag-index and counter allocations, computation and result materialization inside timer; serial implementation.

implementations.name: rust-preinitialized
implementations.processing_boundary: Global eight-thread Rayon pool created before JSON decoding and processing timer; scratch buffers and tag index inside processing timer; no explicit pool teardown in processing timer.

implementations.name: rust-mech-control-streaming
implementations.processing_boundary: JSON decoding outside timer; input flattening and offset/tag-buffer allocations, unchanged numeric generation and result materialization inside timer; serial implementation, no worker pool. Histogram uses one borrowed-key hash pass, sorts only distinct keys; all numeric generation and result materialization unchanged.

implementations.name: rust-mech-control-u32-casts
implementations.processing_boundary: After JSON decoding; flattening, histogram, eligibility, checked byte-bounded U32 key arithmetic, all per-input allocations, scoring and output materialization inside timer; serial.

implementations.name: rust-mech-control-u8-ids-u32
implementations.processing_boundary: After JSON decoding; flattening, histogram, eligibility, one checked byte-ID vector, U32 key arithmetic, all per-input allocations, scoring and output materialization inside timer; serial.

implementations.name: mech-parent-original-4
implementations.processing_boundary: Separate legacy processing timer; authoritative post_json_seconds is one continuous interval after JSON decoding through input admission, intervening setup, output-slot allocation, native invocation, internal cleanup and result materialization. One invocation per fresh process; complete-process time includes restoration, JSON IO and final destruction. Native port adapter reads input/output metadata from the restored checked native descriptor, avoiding a redundant full source-artifact decode. All remaining setup stays inside the complete-process clock.

matrix_rationale: Retain standard output oracle, the three leading matched Rust controls, the latest full-process Rust winner, selected IR208, current IR231 parent and the IR232 candidate. Eight entries replace the earlier45-entry cohort; no previous winning external reference is omitted.
source_variant_tradeoff: The ordering guard directs unordered rows to the original exact fallback; this may regress unordered-input performance.
